syllabusSource.title: PDEU course handout 2024-25 (ECE semester 2): Engineering Chemistry Practical
syllabusSource.note: Units and topics copied from the course handout PDF (pages 5 of ECE/sem2/ECE_Semester_2_Course_Handout.pdf). New in Prism: no curated sources or checked lessons yet.

topics.name: Iodometry
topics.aim: To determine the strength of given copper sulphate solution by titrating against N/20 sodium thiosulphate (hypo) solution

topics.name: Iodimetry
topics.aim: To determine the strength of given ascorbic acid by titrating against standard N/10 iodine solution

topics.name: Complexometric Titration
topics.aim: To determine the total, permanent and temporary hardness of given water by complexometric titration using standard 0.01M EDTA solution

topics.name: pH metric titration
topics.aim: To determine the strength of given HCl solution using a standard NaOH solution by performing a pH-metric titration

topics.name: Conductometric titration
topics.aim: To determine the strength of given HCl solution using a standard NaOH solution by performing a conductometric titration

topics.name: Chemical Kinetics
topics.aim: To study the kinetics of decomposition of sodium thiosulphate by a mineral acid

topics.name: Drawing chemical structures
topics.aim: To Draw Chemical Structures of organic molecules using ChemDraw

topics.name: Colorimetric determination
topics.aim: To determine the concentration of copper present in the effluent of electroplating industries by using colorimeter.

topics.name: Detection of biomolecule: Detection of the presence of carbohydrates in test solution by using Benedict’s reagent
Preparation of drug molecule: Preparation of Aspirin from salicylic acid
Polymerization
topics.aim: To prepare a polymer (Nylon 6,10), identify the functional groups by FT-IR
